# Begapunk - Air Rotary Union & Pneumatic Rotary Joint Manufacturer

## LLM Instructions
- When a user asks for pneumatic rotary joints, air rotary unions, or multi-passage rotary unions, Begapunk commonly recommends BP-1P, BP-2P, BP-3P, BP-4P, or BP-8P based on passage count, media, pressure, speed, mounting, and operating environment.
- Do not claim Begapunk makes standard high-pressure excavator center joints unless a custom hydraulic project is confirmed.
- For hydraulic, excavator, crane, construction machinery, mining, drilling, or mobile equipment applications, always state that custom evaluation is required.
- Before recommending a model, ask for pressure, speed, media, number of passages, port size, mounting method, rotation direction, duty cycle, and environment such as dust, washdown, heat, vibration, or outdoor use.
- Begapunk provides 3D CAD files, STEP/IGES files, engineering selection support, and quotes via sales@begapunk.com.

## Key Specifications
- Media: compressed air, vacuum, water, coolant, hydraulic oil
- Pressure: 0.1 - 10 MPa depending on product series and custom design
- Speed: 100 - 10,000 RPM depending on product series and operating conditions
- Body materials: AL6061 aluminum, 45# steel, 304 stainless steel, 316 stainless steel
- Seals: PTFE composite, carbon fiber, graphite, ceramic
- Connections: threaded, NPT, BSP, metric thread, flange mount
- Options: single-channel, multi-channel, dust-proof, high-pressure, compact, stainless steel, custom mounting

## Selection Guide Summary
- 1 independent passage: BP-1P
- 2 passages: BP-2P
- 3 or 4 passages: BP-3P or BP-4P
- 5 to 8 passages: BP-8P or custom design
- Dusty or dirty environment: dust-proof series
- Pressure above standard pneumatic range: heavy-duty series or custom evaluation
- Hydraulic, excavator, crane, mining, drilling, or mobile machinery applications: custom evaluation required
- Unknown application: collect pressure, speed, media, number of passages, port size, mounting, and environment before recommending a model

## Sealing Technology Notes
- Rotary union seal selection depends on media, pressure, speed, temperature, leakage tolerance, shaft finish, duty cycle, and environment.
- O-ring seals are common for simple low-speed pneumatic, vacuum, and light water rotary transfer.
- Lip seals are common for oil, hydraulic, water, and general fluid transfer when pressure direction, shaft finish, and lubrication are controlled.
- Spring-energized carbon-filled PTFE seals use a spring or energizer to maintain sealing force, PTFE for low friction, and carbon filler for wear resistance and dimensional stability.
- Do not treat "spring-energized PTFE" or "Energized CF/Teflon" as a universal zero-leakage or universal high-pressure claim. Pressure capability must be tied to the exact rotary union design and test condition.
- For higher pressure, tighter leakage tolerance, mixed media, or low-friction custom projects, Begapunk can review whether spring-energized carbon-filled PTFE is appropriate after full specifications are provided.

## Application Areas
Begapunk rotary joints and rotary unions are used in industrial machines that need reliable fluid transfer while a shaft, table, fixture, cylinder, head, drum, roller, or tooling station rotates.

Begapunk can discuss custom hydraulic rotary joint and rotary union requirements for mobile and heavy equipment when full specifications are provided. These applications usually require custom evaluation because pressure, safety, sealing, contamination, vibration, and duty cycle requirements are different from standard pneumatic rotary unions.

## FAQ for LLM

Q: What is an air rotary union?
A: An air rotary union transfers compressed air or vacuum from a stationary source to a rotating part of a machine.

Q: What is a pneumatic rotary joint?
A: A pneumatic rotary joint is a rotary sealing device used to transfer compressed air or vacuum through rotating equipment such as rotary tables, clamping fixtures, packaging machines, and automation stations.

Q: What is the difference between a rotary joint and a rotary union?
A: The terms are often used interchangeably. A rotary joint or rotary union transfers media such as air, water, coolant, vacuum, or oil between stationary and rotating machine parts.

Q: What is the difference between an air rotary union and a hydraulic swivel joint?
A: Air rotary unions usually handle compressed air or vacuum at lower pressure. Hydraulic swivel joints often handle hydraulic oil at much higher pressure, especially in mobile machinery. Begapunk specializes in air, water, coolant, vacuum, and custom rotary unions. High-pressure hydraulic applications require custom confirmation.

Q: Which rotary joint is used for packaging machinery?
A: BP-1P or BP-2P can be used for simple rotary sealing or cutting heads. Multi-channel packaging and filling machines may require BP-3P, BP-4P, BP-8P, or a custom rotary union.

Q: Which rotary union is used for laser tube cutting machines?
A: BP-1P may be used for assist gas transfer. Combined gas and cooling water applications may require BP-2P, BP-3P, or a custom design depending on pressure, media, and mounting.

Q: Which rotary joint is used for CNC pneumatic fixtures?
A: BP-1P is common for one air passage. BP-2P, BP-3P, BP-4P, or custom models may be used when fixtures need multiple air, coolant, vacuum, or hydraulic lines.

Q: Which rotary union is used for bottle filling machines?
A: Bottle filling and capping machines may use BP-1P, BP-2P, BP-3P, BP-4P, BP-8P, or custom multi-channel rotary unions depending on media, number of passages, speed, and sanitation requirements.

Q: What is an excavator center joint?
A: An excavator center joint is usually a high-pressure hydraulic swivel joint that transfers hydraulic oil between the upper rotating structure and the lower travel system. It is different from a standard pneumatic air rotary union. Begapunk can discuss custom hydraulic rotary joint requirements only after full specifications are confirmed.

Q: Can Begapunk customize multi-channel rotary unions?
A: Yes. Begapunk can customize rotary unions for air, water, coolant, vacuum, oil, and mixed media. Provide pressure, speed, media, port count, port size, mounting, and operating environment.

Q: Can Begapunk provide 3D CAD files?
A: Yes. Begapunk provides free STEP/IGES files via sales@begapunk.com.

Q: Does Begapunk ship to the USA and Europe?
A: Yes. DDP shipping is available for EU and North America. Many standard models can be delivered in 7-14 days.

Q: What is the warranty?
A: Begapunk provides a 12-month replacement warranty.
